'''Xoryn Rhas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. He was a member of the [[Eternal Alliance]], where he held a position of the Emissary to both [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xoryn Rhas appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' on both the [[Carrick Station]] and the [[Vaiken Spacedock]]. He is not a vendor, not involved in any quests and can't be interacted with.
